Profit and Loss |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/skipper-ltd/profitandlose/companyid-56366.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=March 2022}} | operating_income = | income_year = | net_income = | net_income_year = | aum = | assets = {{INR}}1166 Crore | assets_year = 2022 | equity = | equity_year = | owner = | num_members = | num_members_year = | num_employees = 2135 | num_employees_year = 2021 | parent = SK Bansal Group | divisions = | subsidiaries = Skipper Pipes | module = | ratio = | rating = | website = {{URL|https://www.skipperlimited.com/|Official website}} | footnotes = }} '''Skipper Limited''' is an Indian [[Transmission tower|transmission]] and distribution structure manufacturing company, founded in 1981. It is headquartered in [[Kolkata]], India. The company is a part of the SK Bansal Group, promoted by Sajan Kumar Bansal. Skipper Limited operates in the [[Power transmission]] and distribution and polymer pipes and fittings segment with presence across sub-segments such as [[Tower]]s, [[Engineering, procurement, and construction|EPC]], Monopoles and Poles. It is the third largest company in India in terms of manufacturing capacity of Power T&D structures.{{cite news |title=Skipper Limited Sets Big Plans for PVC Pipes Business |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/skipper-sets-big-plans-for-pvc-pipes-business-1223835 |publisher=[[NDTV]] |date=September 29, 2015}} It exports to over forty countries across [[South America]], [[Europe]], [[Africa]], the [[Middle East]], [[South Asia]] and [[Australia (continent)|Australia]].{{cite news |title=Skipper bags Rs 405 crore orders in engineering products segment |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/skipper-bags-rs-405-crore-orders-in-engineering-products-segment/articleshow/57814385.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=March 24, 2017}} In 2021, the company was ranked at #61 in ''[[Fortune (magazine)|Fortune]]'' magazine's "Next 500" list of Indian companies. Skipper Limited was listed in India's Top 500 Companies 2016 and 2021 list by [[Dun & Bradstreet]].{{cite news |title=India's TOP 500 Companies 2021 |url=https://www.dnb.co.in/file/publications/india-top-500-companies-2021/34/ |publisher=[[Dun & Bradstreet]] |date=2021}} == History == The company was incorporated as Skipper Investments Limited in 1981. It was renamed Skipper Steels Limited in 1990 and diversified to manufacture [[Telecom Tower]]s and High Masts. It changed its name to Skipper Limited in 2009. It set up an LPG Gas Cylinder unit in 2001, followed by establishing its first tube mill in 2003. In 2005, the company set up its first [[Galvanization|Galvanising]] plant. Skipper received Power grid approval for the Tower unit and got an order for 400kV towers in 2006. In 2007, it forayed into the value addition of [[Transmission tower|Steel Tubes]] as [[scaffolding]]. In 2009, Skipper Limited received an order for 800KV transmission tower from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited. It also commissioned a [[Polymer]] production manufacturing Unit in [[Uluberia]], [[West Bengal]] and a double side Tube GI Plant in 2009.{{cite news |title=India's Top 500 Companies 2016 |url=https://www.dnb.co.in/publications/indiatop500companies2016/skipperlimited.asp |publisher=[[Dun & Bradstreet]]}} In April 2015, Skipper Limited set up a PVC manufacturing facility in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Gujarat]], with a capacity of 10,000 metric tonnes. The Ahmedabad plant was commissioned with an investment of {{INR}} 50 crores.{{cite news |last1=Sengupta |first1=Debjoy |title=Skipper limited sets up PVC manufacturing facility in Gujarat |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/paper-/-wood-/-glass/-plastic/-marbles/skipper-limited-sets-up-pvc-manufacturing-facility-in-gujarat/articleshow/46988281.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=April 20, 2015}} In December 2015, Skipper entered the [[Northeast India]] by commissioning its manufacturing plant in [[Guwahati]], [[Assam]] with a capacity to manufacture 4000 MTPA of plumbing and agricultural pipes.{{cite news |last1=Allirajan |first1=A |title=Skipper commissions PVC plant in Guwahati |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Skipper-commissions-PVC-plant-in-Guwahati/articleshow/50280723.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=December 22, 2015}} In January 2016, the company set up one of India's largest galvanizing plants in [[Uluberia]], [[West Bengal]]. The plant is meant for structures that are 2.5m in diameter and 12m in length. The total galvanizing capacity of the plant is 8000 tonnes per month.{{cite news |title="Skipper installs one of India's largest galvanizing plants in WB" |url=https://www.themachinist.in/print_article/worldwidemedia/news/1640/skipper-installs-india-largest-galvanizing-plants-wb?print=true |work=The Machinist |date=January 25, 2016}} It set up a PVC products plant in [[Sikandrabad]], [[Uttar Pradesh]] in 2016, which has a capacity of about 8,000 metric tonnes.{{cite news |last1=Rao |first1=Rakesh |title=Skipper commissions PVC products plant in Uttar Pradesh |url=https://www.business-standard.com/content/b2b-plastics-polymers/skipper-commissions-pvc-products-plant-in-uttar-pradesh-116020300501_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=February 3, 2016}} In March 2017, the company invested {{INR}}70 crores and set up a new plant in [[Palasbari]], [[Guwahati]], which has a capacity to manufacture 30,000 tonnes of [[engineering]] products and 7000 tonnes of [[polymer]] products annually.{{cite news |title=Skipper Ltd commissions second plant in Guwahati |url=https://www.business-standard.com/content/b2b-plastics-polymers/skipper-ltd-commissions-second-plant-in-guwahati-117032900392_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=March 29, 2017 |location=[[Kolkata]]}} == Operations == Skipper Limited is engaged in the power distribution and transmission infrastructure sectors. It exports its products to more than forty countries, including those in [[South America]], [[Europe]], [[Africa]], the [[Middle East]], [[South Asia]] and [[Southeast Asia]], and [[Australia (continent)|Australia]]. It undertakes activity from angle rolling to fabrication and galvanising, proto assembly, load testing and EPC line construction. Under the brand name Skipper Pipes, it manufactures polymer pipes and fittings that serve the agricultural and plumbing sectors.{{cite news |title=Skipper growth path |url=https://epaperarchives.telegraphindia.com/details/151843-33033265.html |publisher=[[The Telegraph India]] |date=April 19, 2015}} Skipper has 20% of its business coming from the PVC pipes segment and infrastructure projects.{{cite news |last1=Vora |first1=Rutan |title=Skipper plans 25,000 TPA capacity addition in T&D segment |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/skipper-plans-25000-tpa-capacity-addition-in-tampd-segment/article7566134.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=January 23, 2018}} Skipper Pipes has a turnover of {{INR}}330 crores in 2022, contributing to around 19 percent of Skipper's total revenues. Skipper Pipes was started in 2009–2010. The company mainly focused on the eastern and northeastern markets until 2015–2016. It slowly started covering other markets in 2017. As of 2022, it has about 120 distributors and 18,000 retailers across India.{{cite news |last1=Roy |first1=Shobha |title=Skipper Pipes looking to double revenues with newer markets |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/skipper-pipes-looking-to-double-revenues-with-newer-markets/article65753778.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=August 10, 2022}} As of 2018, Skipper Limited has three manufacturing facilities in [[Howrah]] district in [[West Bengal]], two in [[Guwahati]], [[Assam]] and one in [[Hyderabad]]. As of 2017, the capacity of the engineering products division is 230,000 MTPA, while the capacity of the polymer division is 48,000 MTPA. It has 175,000 tonnes of tower-making capacity. As of 2017, the cumulative production capacity of the Skipper Limited was 300000 MTPA.{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/skipper-set-to-increase-pvc-pipes-capacity-by-four-times/article7101968.ece|title=Skipper set to expand PVC pipes capacity by four times|date=14 April 2015|publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]]|accessdate=4 March 2017}}{{cite web|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/Skipper-Ltd-Q1-net-jumps-37-to-Rs-13-72-crore/articleshow/53599432.cms|title=Skipper Ltd Q1 net jumps 37% to Rs 13.72 crore|date=8 August 2016|work=[[The Times of India]]|accessdate=18 March 2017}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/skipper-to-power-up-on-infra-push-in-northeast/article9606629.ece|title=Skipper to power up on infra push in North-East|work=[[Business Line]]|date=August 8, 2018|language=en}} == Partnership == Skipper Limited tied up with [[Ramboll]], a Danish Engineering company as a manufacturing partner, in the year 2006. In 2015, it entered into a partnership with global giant Japan-based Sekisui Chemical as a technology tie-up for manufacturing CPVC Pipes in India. It partnered with the [[Netherlands]]-based [[Wavin |Wavin Group]] for exclusive rights to sell the Hep2o Polybutylene push-fit plumbing systems.{{cite news |title=Skipper enters into two separate partnership with Sekisui & Wavin group |url=https://www.moneyworks4me.com/company/news/index/id/154159?PageSpeed=noscript |work=Moneyworks4me |date=June 9, 2015}} In 2017, Skipper Limited formed a joint venture with [[Israel]]-based Metzerplas, a manufacturer of irrigation equipment.{{cite news |title=Skipper hits record high; to tie-up with Metzerplas of Israel |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/skipper-hits-record-high-to-tie-up-with-metzerplas-of-israel-117112700321_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=November 27, 2017 |location=[[Mumbai]]}} == Financials == The company reported total revenue of {{INR}}1,711.09 crores in March 2022, while it had registered {{INR}}1,585.53 crores in March 2021. In the financial year 2019–20, the company recorded total revenue of {{INR}}1,392.47 crores.{{cite web |title=Skipper Ltd. |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/skipper/profit-lossVI/S21 |publisher=[[Moneycontrol.com]] |date=2022 |last1=Com |first1=Moneycontrol }} In June 2018, the company reported a fall of 15% in net profit for the last quarter, with analysts blaming the drop on the decision to diversify into PVC pipes.{{cite news |last1=Nathan |first1=Narendra |title=Stock pick of the week: Why analysts are bullish on Skipper shares |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/wealth/invest/stock-pick-of-the-week-why-analysts-are-bullish-on-skipper-shares/articleshow/64425358.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=Jun 4, 2018}} In the financial year 2016, the segment-wise revenue performance of the company was {{INR}}13,260 million for engineering products, {{INR}}1,525 million for polymer products and {{INR}}277 million for infrastructure projects.{{cite web|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kolkata/Skipper-aims-at-triple-turnover-in-4-years/articleshow/46694081.cms|title=Skipper aims at triple turnover in 4 years|work=[[The Times of India]]|date=March 16, 2015}} It registered a 232 per cent annual growth in its net profit at {{INR}}89 crores for the fiscal year 2015. The company's revenue grew by 26 per cent during the same period to ₹ 1,313 crores. The power T&D business contributed 80 per cent share in the company's overall Rs 1,450 crore revenues for the financial year 2014–15. In 2013–14, it reported revenue of {{INR}}1,165 crore.{{cite news |title=Skipper Ltd to export more transmission towers |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/skipper-ltd-to-export-more-transmission-towers/article7032244.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=25 March 2015 |location=[[Kolkata]]}} == IPO == In 2015, Skipper Limited was listed at [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] with a market capitalization of over {{INR}}15, 000 million (as of March 2015 ending). In 2016, it was listed in the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] with a capital of {{INR}}13,634 million (as of 31 March 2016).{{cite web |url=http://www.finalaya.com:8000/Documents/AnnouncementAttachments/01022016/8648C560_4DA3_4E5F_B5F7_DCB7F3B30448_151257.pdf |title= Announcement|publisher=Finalaya |access-date=2021-04-26}}{{cite web|url=http://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/stockreach_corpinfo.aspx?scripcode=538562&expandable=8|title=Skipper Ltd|work=[[Bseindia.com]]|accessdate=4 March 2017}}{{cite news |last1=Sengupta |first1=Debjoy |title=Skipper Ltd lists at National Stock Exchange |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/skipper-ltd-lists-at-national-stock-exchange/articleshow/47444030.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=May 27, 2015}} == Awards and recognition == In December 2015, Skipper Limited won CBIP Award for the Best Industry in Water Resource Sector for manufacturing [[Plastic piping|Plastic Piping Systems]] from the Central Board of Irrigation and Power, [[Ministry of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation|Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation]] and the [[Government of India]]. The award was presented by [[Uma Bharti]], the Union Minister. The company received the Star Performer award at the 48th [[Engineering Exports Promotion Council|EEPC India]] National Export Awards 2015 by the [[Engineering Exports Promotion Council]]. Skipper Limited has been listed as a ''[[Fortune (magazine)|Fortune]]'' [[Fortune India 500|Next 500]] company for the year 2020, 2021 and 2022. In 2022, it was ranked #61 on [[Fortune (magazine)|Fortune]] Next 500 list under the iron and steel category, by ''[[Fortune India]]''.{{cite news |title=Fortune India The Next 500 |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/next-500/company/skipper?year=2022 |publisher=[[Fortune India]] |date=2022}} {| class="wikitable" |- ! Skipper Limited is an Indian transmission and distribution structure manufacturing company, founded in 1981. It is headquartered in Kolkata, India. The company is a part of the SK Bansal Group, promoted by Sajan Kumar Bansal. Skipper Limited operates in the Power transmission and distribution and polymer pipes and fittings segment with presence across sub-segments such as Towers, EPC, Monopoles and Poles. It is the third largest company in India in terms of manufacturing capacity of Power T&D structures. It exports to over forty countries across South America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, South Asia and Australia.
In 2021, the company was ranked at #61 in Fortune magazine's "Next 500" list of Indian companies. Skipper Limited was listed in India's Top 500 Companies 2016 and 2021 list by Dun & Bradstreet.
